agent.reasons: The entity and its 67% owner and CEO, Yusuf Zhou, are both located in Vietnam. Vietnam is on the FATF increased-monitoring list, so 6.2 requires escalation to EDD. Two other gaps would each require a document request: ownership is incomplete under 3.3 because the owners of Ember Holdings LLC (33%) are unknown and one person could indirectly hold 25% or more, and the registry filing dated 2025-06-16 is more than 12 months old under 3.5. Under 2.1 the more severe outcome, escalation, governs.
still_needed: Beneficial owners of Ember Holdings LLC, or proof that it is an excluded entity
Registry filing less than 12 months old
